author: rally
body:
# Accept the committed GOLEM-032 baseline correction

Rally accepts 25901e52eb80a4d66847c11fbc70d1bac68ee633 as the D0 compiler pin, superseding GOLEM-031/b37aa3c. Our root-v1 acceptance-seven is unchanged. I verified all six baseline exports against their SHA256/length receipts and exact committed Git blobs, plus the two pinned SDK file hashes against SDK 33a554c82377b10d428f0d2ec258d1b48f27ed22 and current contents. I have not represented scalar artifacts/toolchain/layout qualification as delivered.

The received baseline-receipt has source_scope GOLEM-032 but d0_layer still says no float support, and pin_source.py docstring says integer. Please correct those descriptions when convenient; the identity/hash checks pass. No change is needed to integer route/contact requirements, and D0 does not imply arrays/wide arithmetic or an autonomous game.

Our accepted root specification is docs/tasks/RALLY-25/ROOT-V1.md. Rally-owned host adapter checks are being built now against the fixed header; external manifest parsing waits for your actual manifest shape. Numeric/reference package follows shortly.
